selected_branches.branch: Parking in an effective passenger curb loading zone

law_text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle for any purpose or period of time except for the expeditious loading or unloading of passengers in any place marked as a passenger curb loading zone during hours when the regulations applicable to such passenger curb loading zone are effective.

witness_review.branch: Parking in an effective passenger curb loading zone
required_context: Driver parks a qualifying vehicle inside the zone.
Establish effective regulations and civil time from an applicable source.
Establish marked passenger-zone boundaries and adjacency to a highway curb or edge.
Establish responsible person, qualifying vehicle and actual in-zone parking position, purpose, halt history and passenger and merchandise activity rather than inferring activity solely from intent.
Mark a passenger curb loading zone with explicit curb adjacency and boundaries on the one-way road.
Observe actual purpose, passenger and merchandise activity, traffic conflicts and relevant directions.

Record conflicts and police or official-device directions; preserve the express expeditious passenger exception and distinct conduct definitions. Retain unresolved sign-hours and municipal-supersession provenance without asserting supersession.
Supply applicable regulations, source and effective hours, together with civil date, time and time zone.
witness_review.reason: Parking can occur within a passenger-designated realization of the fixed loading-zone marking.
